verdict.rationale: Raygun documents mute/ignore rules for error groups. You can ignore for a specific time period, for a specific number of occurrences, or by rule, which covers the mute/ignore part of the story within its error-status triage workflow. Nothing in the evidence shows spike protection or per-key rate limiting to stop one bad deploy from flooding alerts. Missing for 10: spike protection, per-key/per-application rate limits, evidence that ignore rules suppress paging (e.g., PagerDuty), independent hands-on corroboration.
